items.brief: Tether holds 150,000 bitcoin worth $11.5 billion, CEO Paolo Ardoino says
items.why: Discloses large BTC holdings outside USDT reserves, relevant to reserve transparency.

items.brief: DTCC's tokenization launch could accelerate adoption and boost Securitize, StoneX says
items.why: Suggests DTCC's tokenization service validates tokenized securities models.

items.brief: NYSE tokenized stock plans take shape as four more transfer agents join
items.why: Transfer agents bringing shareholder records and voting onchain supports tokenized equities.

items.brief: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX-ICE tokenized stock plans
items.why: Company opt-outs near the response deadline signal friction for tokenized stock listings.

items.brief: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
items.why: Bank tokenized deposits moving around the clock settle in central bank money.

items.brief: Hong Kong's EnsembleTX pilot now supports 24/7 tokenized central bank money
items.why: Adds 24/7 tokenized central bank money to interbank settlement for tokenized deposits.
